t: There's no theatre here now. This was the site of the Novelty Theatre, which opened in 1882 at number 8 Great Queen Street. Audiences came in from Little Queen Street until 1905, and after that from the new Kingsway. In 1889 it hosted the London premiere of A Doll's House. The theatre closed in 1941, was heavily damaged in the Blitz, and was demolished in 1959. It was designed by Thomas Verity, an English architect of the theatre-building boom between 1885 and 1915.
